Decision: SmartRecruiters is the talent acquisition hub (ATS, CRM, offers, onboarding start); the HR core is the employee system of record
Context: Three legacy ATS tools and spreadsheets; HR core already on a cloud suite
Options considered: Keep legacy; extend HR-core recruiting; one TA hub with HR core as employee record
Decision rationale: One hub with modern AI and open APIs; HR core stays authoritative for employee data; supported interoperability

Decision: All partner traffic goes through the integration hub; no direct partner-to-partner links
Context: Dozens of partner categories across 14 countries
Decision rationale: Single place for mapping, security, monitoring, replacement

Decision: Prefer certified marketplace connectors; build adapters on the partner and customer APIs where none exists
Context: Marketplace lists many categories; some regional partners are absent
Decision rationale: Faster for common partners; adapters keep regional choice open

Decision: Canonical hiring model with mapping tables per partner
Context: Each partner has its own codes and status values
Decision rationale: Swap partners without changing reports or downstream systems

Decision: AI is advisory: no automatic rejection; human decision recorded
Context: Match and screen services plus AI interview scores
Decision rationale: Law, fairness, and trust; supports human-review rights

Decision: Background checks run through a global primary provider plus regional specialists behind one capability interface
Options considered: One global; many local; primary plus specialists
Decision rationale: Coverage and local compliance without multiple processes

Decision: Check results stored as outcome and date; detail stays with the provider
Assessments and AI interviews are multi-vendor, selected by role family, using the Assessment API pattern
Context: Different roles need different tests and interview formats
Options considered: One vendor for all; role-family catalogue
Decision rationale: Better validity per role; vendor change possible

Decision: Hiring events stream to the data platform with pseudonymised keys
Context: Need consistent analytics beyond the hub's own reports
Options considered: Hub reports only; lake plus hub

Decision: Single sign-on and SCIM for staff; partner credentials in a vault
Context: Many partner portals and API clients

Decision: Regional controls and retention table drive data residency and deletion
Decision rationale: Meets local law with one mechanism

Decision: Offer and e-signature in the hub; employment contract and local terms generated from the HR core
Context: Contract terms are country-specific and tied to payroll
Options considered: Hub only; HR core only; split
Decision rationale: Hub manages the candidate decision; HR core owns the legal contract and payroll data

Decision: Every partner category has a documented exit plan and an annual test for critical partners
Decision rationale: Vendor-agnostic in practice, not only in design

Decision: Deliver with SAP Activate: fit-to-standard first, extensions only after an approved gap
Pilot country and one role family first, then waves by region
